cases.title: Minecraft hanging lantern
cases.brief: Create a Minecraft Java block lantern within the 0..16 block bounds: iron frame, warm glowing core, distinct top cap, base and hanging loop. Use cubes compatible with Java block export, a hand-painted 32x32 pixel-art atlas, and readable highlights at inventory-icon scale. Balance appearance and performance; at most 32 cubes. A bright painted core is sufficient; do not imply that the model alone implements game lighting.
acceptance: Recognizable lantern with frame, core, cap, base and loop
Geometry fits 0..16 on every axis and uses Java-compatible cubes
32x32 pixel-art texture and coherent texel density
Readable at small size without excessive tiny geometry
At most 32 cubes; Java runtime model export is valid

cases.title: Creeper-style moss golem
cases.brief: Create a Minecraft Bedrock Creeper-style moss golem: tall cuboid torso, square head, four short independently rigged feet, a readable dark face and mottled moss-green pixel art on a 64x64 atlas. Add an original stone crack motif. About 24 units tall. Balance appearance and performance, at most 32 cubes. Create a seamless 1-second walk cycle with diagonal leg pairing, planted contacts and subtle body bob. Preserve the familiar silhouette while making the stone-and-moss styling original.
acceptance: Tall Creeper-style silhouette, square head and four independently rigged feet
64x64 atlas with readable face and moss/stone distinction
One-second walk loops with diagonal pairing
Leg pivots and ground contacts remain plausible
At most 32 cubes; Bedrock geometry and animation are retained
